snippet.title: 🏄⚖️ Aaron Judge’s epic return to the cover of MLB The Show
snippet.description:
His journey has been record-breaking, but the best is yet to come. We’re so excited to welcome back Aaron Judge as the MLB The Show 26 cover athlete.

Learn more: https://mlbthe.show/7ZMj
